required_evidence: Exact current approved accepted origination; immutable payload; one release intent
transaction_effect: Create command/claim/history/audit and command receipt in one transaction
forbidden_shortcut: Do not create active loan or invoke driver

required_evidence: Current role/scope/MFA/limits and exact version/hash; release basis current
forbidden_shortcut: Same person with both roles cannot authorize

required_evidence: Rechecked basis/authorizer and immutable key/payload; no prior unresolved release
transaction_effect: Commit dispatch claim/attempt before any driver invocation
forbidden_shortcut: No external side effect inside open transaction

required_evidence: Outcome not provably confirmed or definitively failed
transaction_effect: Persist uncertainty and attempt provenance; retain release claim
forbidden_shortcut: Timeout/crash is not failed and not permission to transfer again

required_evidence: Definitive verified no-movement outcome for exact attempt
transaction_effect: Append failure evidence/history; preserve intent and immutable payload

required_evidence: Exact trusted movement/command identity and evidence; simulation mode explicit
transaction_effect: Durable observation/event/state in its own transaction before later posting
forbidden_shortcut: No active loan/posted receipt or GL-success claim

required_evidence: Verified status proves no movement; null reference is not a status
transaction_effect: Append verified evidence and state/history atomically
forbidden_shortcut: Do not infer no movement from missing response/reference

required_evidence: Verified settlement evidence bound to original stable identity
transaction_effect: Persist settlement without new transfer or loss of original attempt
forbidden_shortcut: Do not invoke submit to resolve ambiguity

required_evidence: Status unavailable or ambiguous; no accepted reference-based/key-based proof
transaction_effect: Read status or append new bounded observation without financial effects
forbidden_shortcut: Lease expiry or repeated lookup does not justify new release

required_evidence: Known settlement preserved; posting unavailable/failed/closed period
transaction_effect: Retain observation and visible exception; no duplicate transfer
forbidden_shortcut: Never roll back already committed observation with posting failure

required_evidence: Real servicing event/allocations plus Earl journal and required receipt linked in same transaction
forbidden_shortcut: Phase 4 cannot fake this with a provisional or fabricated journal receipt

required_evidence: Exact duplicate identity/payload or identical committed request
transaction_effect: Return existing permitted reference; no new posting/activation
forbidden_shortcut: Late failure cannot downgrade known settlement or posted success

required_evidence: Original operation/body/version/key; current access still valid
transaction_effect: Replay stored result; separate read supplies current status
forbidden_shortcut: A new key does not create release replacement authority

actor_boundary: Current configured scoped reader or authorized command boundary
required_evidence: Own-resource access; invalid state/version/permission fails without mutation
transaction_effect: No financial effect; sanitized error or authorized read
forbidden_shortcut: No arbitrary browser next-state or balance patch
